description: Free. Re-cut an asset's animations from the videos Voidless stored when it made them, with the current pipeline: cut-out, seamless loop, 30 fps, one size across facings, steady idles. Replaces those frames in place (same ids and names; the old images are kept and can be restored). Only for animations made in an animation set (generate_animation_set) since Voidless started keeping their videos. frameIds: the animation frame ids to re-cut (omit for every re-cuttable animation on the asset).

frameIds.description: Animation frame ids; omit for all

id.description: Asset ID (from list_assets / get_asset or a previous result)

name: reprocess_animation
